name: Heartless Smoker
source:
In a city hospital located in the urban center, Maya and Arman meet on the rooftop one afternoon. Maya, a young girl with a dark past, and Arman, a desperate father trying to save his daughter's life, find themselves in a situation where kindness and sacrifice become the core of their decisions.

[From [url=https://catleap.itch.io/heartless-smoker]itch.io[/url]]
